title: Syndiam
description: A mix of performance and quality, just right.
body:
**_Syndiam_** is a modpack designed to give a high quality gameplay experience while sacrificing te least amount of performance possible.

## Key Mods:

### Performance Enhancers:
Sodium, Indium, Iris
### World Enhancements:
BetterGrass, EnhancedBlockEntities, Continuity
### Customization:
Cloth Config, ModMenu, ObsidianUI
### Quality of Life: 
FastQuit, Dynamic FPS, BadOptimizations
### Visuals & Audio: 
Animatica, Polytone, EntitySoundFeatures


Forge your path in a world that is as fast as it is beautiful.
